roles.superadmin: Welcome Admin. Here is a detailed operational guide for this page:
roles.cashier: Welcome. To ensure a smooth workflow, please read this guide carefully:

/.title: Dashboard
/.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Provides a comprehensive overview of the store's financial and administrative health from a single screen.

⚙️ Detailed Instructions:
• Top Cards: Quick summary of Total Supplier Debts, Due This Week, Expenses, and Active Employees.
• Charts: 📊 Visually tracks expense distribution and your top creditors.
• Alerts: 🔔 The bottom lists show urgent tasks. Click the 'Pay Now' button next to an alert to settle and record it immediately.

/pos.title: Point of Sale (POS)
/pos.content:
🎯 Purpose:
The main interface for serving customers quickly and accurately.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Open Shift: 🔓 Before selling, enter your starting drawer cash and click 'Open Shift'.
2. Add Items:
   - 📠 Fast method: Scan the item with the Barcode Scanner.
   - 🔍 Manual method: Click the search bar and type, or click the product card.
3. Edit Cart: 🛒 Click the number next to an item in the cart to change its quantity, or click the (🗑️ icon) to remove it.
4. Pay: 💳 Click the large blue 'Pay' button to calculate the total, open the drawer, and print the thermal ticket.

/end-of-day.title: End of Day (Z-Report)
/end-of-day.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Monitor active shifts and close the financial day to secure profits and reset drawers.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Monitor Shifts: 👀 View cards of active cashiers showing their check-in time and live sales.
2. Force Close: 🛑 If a cashier forgot to close their shift, click the red 'Close Shift' button. Enter the 'Actual Cash' physically counted in the drawer.
3. Z-Report: 🌙 Ensure all shifts are closed, then click the large 'Close Business Day' button to archive sales and reset the system for tomorrow.

/expenses.title: Expenses & Advances
/expenses.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Document any cash leaving the drawers (bills, maintenance, advances) to prevent financial shortages.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Add Expense: Click the blue 'Add Expense' button (➕ icon).
2. Fill Data:
   - 📥 Select 'Source Drawer' (Admin or Cashier).
   - 📁 Choose the 'Category'.
   - 👤 If 'Staff Advance', choose the employee's name (auto-deducted from salary later).
   - ✏️ Enter amount and description.
3. Save: 💾 Click 'Save' to immediately deduct the amount from the drawer.

/suppliers.title: Suppliers & Debts
/suppliers.content:
🎯 Purpose:
A digital ledger tracking every incoming invoice and outgoing payment.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. New Supplier: ➕ Click 'New Supplier' at the top to register one.
2. Search: 🔍 Use the search bar to find a supplier quickly.
3. Manage Debts:
   - 👁️ Click 'Details' (⋯ icon) next to the supplier.
   - 📈 Add Debt: Click 'Add Receipt' and enter the invoice value.
   - 📉 Make Payment: Click 'Add Payment', enter the amount, and select the source drawer to justify the cash out.

/hr.title: HR & Staff
/hr.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Manage the team, track live attendance, and generate access badges.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Fast Check-in: 📠 The left scanner area is for employees to scan their badges to check in/out.
2. Add Employee: ➕ Go to the 'Employees' tab, click 'Add Employee', and set their role (determines system access).
3. PIN Code: 🔑 Assign a unique PIN as an electronic signature.
4. Print Badge: 🪪 Click the 'Badge' button next to their name to print a barcode ID.

/payroll.title: Smart Payroll
/payroll.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Calculate exact salaries based on attendance hours and auto-deduct advances.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Setup: 📅 Select the employee and click the calendar icon to choose the date range.
2. Calculate: ⏱️ Enter the hourly rate. The system aggregates hours to calculate the 'Gross Salary'.
3. Auto-Deduct: ➖ The system subtracts registered advances to show the 'Net Salary'.
4. Pay: 💰 Click 'Pay and Save'.
5. Rollover: 🔄 If advances exceed the salary, the system asks to roll over the remaining debt to the next month as a new advance.

/agenda.title: Agenda & Tasks
/agenda.content:
🎯 Purpose:
A smart calendar reminding you of important deadlines to avoid penalties.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Add Task: ➕ Click 'Add Task'. Enter the title, type, and use the (📅 icon) to set the date.
2. Alerts: 🔔 Due tasks will appear in the notification bell and the Dashboard.
3. Interact: Click (✅ icon) to mark a task as completed, or (✏️ icon) to reschedule it.

/inventory.title: Inventory Management
/inventory.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Build an organized product tree and track prices and stock levels.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Structure: 📁 Click 'Add Family' (e.g., Dairy), then select it to add a 'Type' (e.g., Yogurt).
2. Add Item: ➕ Select the Type, click 'Add Product', and enter the name, price, and pieces per box.
3. Manual Edit: ✏️ During physical counting, click the edit icon to correct system quantities to match reality.

/store-map.title: 3D Store Map
/store-map.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Draw a digital map matching your physical store for Smart Invoice Imports.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Draw: 🗄️ Drag and drop (Shelf/Fridge icons) into the workspace.
2. Customize: ⚙️ Double-click a shelf to name it and set its capacity.
3. Rotate: ↻ Select a shelf and use the rotate icon to change its direction.
4. Save: 💾 Click the green 'Save Map' button. Ensure you click 'Activate' to make it the default map.

/pdf-importer.title: Smart PDF Importer
/pdf-importer.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Save hours of data entry by letting AI read supplier invoices.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Upload: 📎 Click the dashed area and select a PDF invoice (Bon de Livraison).
2. Extract: 🤖 Wait a few seconds for AI to extract barcodes, names, and quantities.
3. Routing: 🔗 The system suggests the best shelf based on your '3D Map'. Use the dropdown to correct it if needed.
4. Save: 💾 Click 'Save & Link' to instantly inject all items into the inventory.

/archive.title: Daily Archive
/archive.content:
🎯 Purpose:
The secure vault to revisit past financial days and extract reports.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Browse: 📅 View closed days sorted from newest to oldest.
2. Details: 👁️ Click the eye icon to view each cashier's performance, shortages, and expenses.
3. Print: 
   - 🧾 Click the receipt icon for a thermal printout.
   - 📄 Click the Word icon to download a detailed A4 report for the accountant.

/audit-logs.title: Audit Logs
/audit-logs.content:
🎯 Purpose:
The sleepless eye of management. Records every click and action by users to prevent fraud.

⚙️ How to read it?
• The table shows: (Who did it?), (Action Type), (Details), and the exact (Date & Time ⏱️).
• Filter: 🔍 Use the search bar to type an employee's name and track all their actions.

/settings.title: Users & Settings
/settings.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Control system access, accounts, and permissions.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Add User: ➕ Click 'Add User'. Enter username, password, and role.
2. Permissions: 🛡️ Cashiers cannot view profits, payroll, or audit logs. Super Admins have full control.
3. Delete: 🗑️ If an employee leaves, click the trash icon immediately to revoke system access.

/attendance.title: General Attendance
/attendance.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Review check-in/out times for all staff and fix missing records.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Filter: 📅 Use the calendar icon to select a specific day.
2. Manual Edit: ✏️ If an employee forgot to check out, click the edit icon to manually enter the correct exit time for accurate payroll.

/cashier-attendance.title: Fast Attendance
/cashier-attendance.content:
🎯 Purpose:
A popup window for quick check-ins without leaving the POS screen.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Trigger: ⌨️ Press (Ctrl + Shift + A) anywhere in the system to open the popup.
2. Scan: 🔑 Scan your ID badge or enter your PIN.
3. Confirm: ✅ Wait for the green 'Success' message to ensure your time is logged.
